title: Part 9
content_zh: Thirty spokes converge on one hub, but it is the emptiness that makes the wheel useful. Clay is shaped into a vessel, but it is the emptiness that makes it useful. Therefore, being gives possibility, but non-being gives usefulness.
content_en: Thirty spokes converge on one hub, but it is the emptiness that makes the wheel useful. Clay is shaped into a vessel, but it is the emptiness that makes it useful. Therefore, being gives possibility, but non-being gives usefulness.
